summary: Helena NF lookout 7 miles south of Lincoln, MT: a 20-ft pole L-4 tower built 1934, destroyed 1971 per firelookout.com; no description of the site today found.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1971 according to firelookout.com; no source read describes what remains on the site

access.note: No source read describes public access to the site

events.note: Alf Wendler of Lincoln stationed at the lookout in July 1933, per a Helena newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts
firelookout.com lists the 20-foot pole L-4 tower for 1934; the April 1934 newspaper item describes the new station under construction with a July 1 deadline
firelookout.com gives 'Destroyed 1971'; no second source was read

sources.title: Dalton Mountain (Forest Lookouts, Montana), quoting Independent (Helena) items from 1933 and 1934

notes_for_editor: The 1971 destruction date rests on firelookout.com alone; two web searches found no second source. Only the two lookout pages and the 1933-34 newspaper items quoted on the Forest Lookouts page were read; the NHLR and FFLOS registers hold no entry for this site. Firelookout.com gives elevation 6767 ft; the record has none. Record coordinates were not checked against the 7-mile description. The 1933 items mention an existing lookout before the 1934 tower; the sources do not say whether the new tower replaced it. Story is about 150 words.
